name: Korea United Pharm Inc.
summary: Korea United Pharm Inc. is a South Korean enterprise dedicated to the development, production, and distribution of a wide array of pharmaceutical products. The company's extensive portfolio encompasses therapeutic solutions for various medical fields, such as the respiratory, musculoskeletal, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, and central nervous systems, in addition to treatments for cancer, infections, allergies, and immune disorders. It also supplies over-the-counter drugs. While deeply rooted in the South Korean market, the firm extends its reach internationally, exporting its medications to nearly 40 countries. Founded in 1987, Korea United Pharm Inc. is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
